title: [Review] Sacheu Thick Skin / Barrier Repair
text:
I bought this based on a Redditor's recommendation. I have very dry, normally *not* sensitive skin. Maybe it's because I love splashing on hydrating essences...I don't know what got into me. But I splashed a ton of Timeless Vitamin C on my neck last week and ended up with scary sandpaper skin and a developing rash. It's the first time I have messed up my skin barrier.

After my **Sacheu Thick Skin** ([link](https://sacheu.com/products/thick-skin-essential-lipids-serum)) arrived I was paranoid to use a new product. And my mild products only routine was working, but so S L O W L Y. This morning I applied Time Revolution FTE, Pyunkang Yul Essence Toner, Thick Skin, then Tatcha Ageless Enriching Renewal Cream and squalane oil. Thick skin was the only new product. *Four hours later* I have an almost perfectly smooth neck. 

This serum is very thick feeling and has a lot of silicone. Honestly it's not something I would have bought if I'd tried it on in a store. But I'm so glad I did!  

I haven't figured out yet if this is going to be a daily or nightly thing once my neck is totally normal again.

title: [Routine help]About to start Differin - routine help please?
text:
Sorry for any formatting issues, i'm on my phone at work.  But the title about says it.  i'm a medic and i work 24 hour shifts, so my "days" are a little weird.  i can't really have gym days on work days because it just annoys me too much, so the routine changes midday when i hit the gym on my off days. We work Kelly shifts (24 on/24 off x3, then 4 days off...example, maybe i'm on MWF then off until Wednesday). Current routine:

AM:
- Either Neutrogena makeup wipe or micellar water (Simple or blue top Garnier...i like them both equally so i buy whichever happens to be cheaper) to remove PM routine, then shower
- Pixi Glow Tonic
- Tatcha Essence
- Tatcha Gold Camellia Beauty Oil
- Tatcha Water Gel 
- Tatcha Deep Hydration Firming Serum
- Tatcha Ageless Revitalizing Eye Cream
- Tatcha Silk Cream
- Tatcha Dewy Cream
- Biore Aqua Rich Watery Essence Sunscreen (Incidenrally, thinking of switching to Tonymoly BCDation Sun Oil though?  Thoughts?)
- No makeup.  Ever.

Gym:
- Makeup Wipe or Micellar water (pre and post)
- Tatcha Camellia Cleansing Oil (pre and post)
- Pixi Milky Tonic or Rose Tonic (whatever my skin needs, sometimes both)
- Tatcha Beauty Oil
- Tatcha Water Gel
- Tatcha Water Cream
- Biore Sunscreen

PM:
- Micellar water
- Tatcha Camellia Cleansing Oil
- Tatcha Rice Polish (various formulations based on skin needs)
- Red Box Stridex (roughly every other night)
- Pixi Retinol Tonic
- Tatcha Essence
- Tatcha Beauty Oil (if i didn't use any midday)
- Tatcha Violet C Brightening Serum
- Tatcha Luminous Dewy Skin Night Concentrate
- Tatcha Ageless Revitalizing Eye Cream
- Tatcha Ageless Enriching Renewing Cream
- Glow Recipe Watermelon/Avocado Sleeping Masks (diagnostic relative to skin needs, and only when i'm not at work - these aren't things i'm willing to get toned out and provide patient care wearing 😳)

Extras:
- Tatcha Luminous Dewy Skin Mist all day, every day, throughout the day.  i'd die without this stuff.
- Tatcha Violet C Radiance Mask at least once a week
- Tatcha Luminous Dewy Skin Sheet Mask maybe weekly
- Eminence Organics Coconut Cream mask weekly
- Pixi FortifEYE patches - try for every night i'm not sleeping at the station but i frequently fail at life
- Various cheap impulse buys from target


i don't really have any skin concerns other than genetically shitty thin skin under my eyes that gives me perpetually tired looking dark circles.  i rarely break out, and when i do, it's short lived and far from catastrophic. Usually a single pimple that goes away in a day or two, right around when i would have my period had the flying spaghetti monster not invented IUDs.  The pores on my cheeks right under my eyes are a little larger than i'd like and i'm maybe noticing elevens and a the beginnings of a couple forehead lines.  Overall, i'm super lucky but it could be better.  

So my questions are:

- Where should i put the Differin into an already somewhat complex routine?  Please keep in mind i live in Alaska and it's summer time, and working 24s mean i'm almost guaranteed to be outside in the daylight almost any time, no matter when i put it on.
- Should i start slow or just plow right into it?
- What should i expect on Differin? i've heard all kinds of purge horror stories, so i'm more than a little apprehensive.  How cranky and irritated are we looking at?  i'm considering ordering the Indigo (soothing/calming/whatever) cream to have on hand just in case.
- While i'm a die hard Tatcha fan, i'm not opposed to trying other stuff if it delivers results.  So if you've got something better, or a cheaper lateral move, i'm all for it.  
- Is the overall routine solid? Is there anything i should start/discontinue/reorder?

You're all amazing humans.  Thank you for you 🥰😘
